title: EDG Community Update: July 4th, 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- [The Twitter Meme Competition](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1546164048013787136?s=20&t=hIDnxvlcPCXR6F-sM0XLpw) aka campaign 2 from The Cutting Edge Conquest series has been kicked off and will be open for entries until 6 pm UTC on 18th July.
- [An update on Kabocha's genesis issuance, treasury and EDG and crowdloan distributions](https://twitter.com/kabochanetwork/status/1544452785118351361?s=20&t=8bE-Yq0fMBJobFzm2eHSWA) is out!
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP5/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP5/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Upcoming Activities: The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns, Kabocha’s Technical AMA ft. Ramsey and Rusty Crewmates, Kabocha’s Community Mods Onboarding Quiz
- Recently hosted event: [AMA with '<Placeholder> Labs'](https://youtu.be/49lSwhjuPLw)


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [OnFinality published the June 2022 usage report](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bVnCZ-lDiG5nnE8d2AAfYMF8Qan8lrRsv5lZPg9ZKiI/edit?usp=sharing) of their load-balancing RPC infrastructure for Edgeware solochain mainnet. Overall there were 48.9 million requests with 37.7GB of data traffic.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-july-3/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcomed to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up
